changelog: README-only documentation: complete functionality, usage, permissions, security/privacy, related emojis, and corrected TREE-SHA256-v1 verification excluding registry-generated metadata; no functional files changed
summary: Prevents "agent stopped responding / stuck / no output" failures in sandboxed agent runtimes (Arena Agent Mode, OpenClaw, Codex) where a single long tool call blocks the turn and stdin is closed so interactive prompts hang forever. Provides the detach → bounded-poll → durable-state pattern plus a ready-to-use jobctl.sh runner. Use when: a build/download/model-inference/mass-install takes minutes, a CLI may prompt for input, or the user reports the agent freezing mid-task.
